title: Move from the whole world to the single opening that matters

motion.summary: A wide storm view establishes the ark and its tiny warm entrance, then the cut isolates a close doorway seam so that the same warm light becomes the dominant object.
phases: Show a large threatened environment with one small warm focal point.
Cut much closer while preserving the recognizable light and material.
Let the sentence occupy the newly simplified detail composition.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Use a consistent visual anchor to make a large change of scale feel narratively connected.
variations: Move from a city to one lit window, a battlefield to a held object, or a machine to one moving part.
Use a solid-colored aperture as the anchor for a fully graphic version.
Reverse the scale change to reveal the larger consequences of a small action.
cautions: Do not present this sequence as proof of a door slam: the warm seam remains visible in these frames.
Give the close composition its own designed text clearance.
Avoid a repeated zoom on one source image when a genuinely new composition is called for.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: The warm entrance is easy to locate within both scales.
The world-to-detail edit directs attention to a specific narrative boundary.
limitations: The sampled source retains a conspicuous bright seam through the last frame.
Added lightning and rain do not establish that every detail in the photographic source is animated.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
